description: Source code for a Zephyr-based shell module implementing devmem (device memory) read/write commands, including memory dump, load, and bypass functionalities.

methods.name: is_ascii
methods.description: Checks if a byte is an ASCII character (digits 0-9, a-f, A-F).

methods.name: memory_dump
methods.description: Performs a memory dump from a physical address with specified width and size.

methods.name: set_bypass
methods.description: Sets or clears the bypass mode for devmem operations.

methods.name: bypass_cb
methods.description: Callback for handling bypass data, including byte parsing and endianness conversion.

methods.name: cmd_load
methods.description: Loads data into memory, supporting options for endianness.

methods.name: memory_read
methods.description: Reads memory at a specified address with given width.

methods.name: memory_write
methods.description: Writes a value to memory at a specified address with given width.

methods.name: cmd_devmem
methods.description: Main command for reading or writing memory, or performing a dump.
